summary: Generated coverage for new Admin-Spielerverwaltung feature (SQL 035/036 + AdminPlayerManager.tsx): server self-test, admin search/detail, coins+fishing-cast grant confirmation/idempotency, grant log, non-admin redirect, player-side bonus-casts chip, and admin-grant-notice toast/mark-seen. 8/8 criteria covered. One real bug found and confirmed via source inspection: mark_admin_grant_notices_seen is never sent to the network.

bugs.criterion: Spieler-App: Bonus-Angelversuche und Meldung (my_admin_grant_notices / mark_admin_grant_notices_seen part)
bugs.description: The toast for an admin coin/cast grant displays correctly (title + reason, e.g. 'Du hast 500 Leonida Coins erhalten! Event-Gewinn'), but mark_admin_grant_notices_seen is NEVER sent to the network, so the server-side notice is never marked seen and will likely re-toast on every refetch/revisit. Root cause (src/lib/admin-players.ts, useAdminGrantNotices effect, ~line 117): `void sb.rpc("mark_admin_grant_notices_seen", { _ids: ids });` is called without `await`/`.then()`. @supabase/postgrest-js's PostgrestBuilder is a lazy PromiseLike — its constructor only builds the request; the actual fetch is only triggered from inside its own `.then()` implementation (node_modules/@supabase/postgrest-js/src/PostgrestBuilder.ts lines ~359-367). Calling the builder without awaiting or chaining `.then()` therefore never issues the HTTP request. Fix: change to `void sb.rpc(...).then(...)` or (better) `await sb.rpc(...)` inside an async IIFE/effect.
bugs.evidence: Browser check admin-grant-notice-toast-marks-seen: full captured request list after the toast renders contains my_fishing_state, my_coin_balance, my_admin_grant_notices, my_account_ban, has_role, profile_cards, spots, etc. but NOT mark_admin_grant_notices_seen. No console/page errors or unhandled promise rejections were logged. Confirmed by reading node_modules/@supabase/postgrest-js/src/PostgrestBuilder.ts: the fetch call lives inside the then() method itself, making the builder returned by sb.rpc() a lazy thenable.
